newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH PK CABLES PLANS IPO, LISTING.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH PK CABLES PLANS IPO, LISTING.

text.p: Finnish cables maker PK Cables Oy said in a statement on Tuesday it would offer 2.6 million shares to domestic and foreign institutional and retail investors at 46.00 markka per share, and seek a bourse listing.
"The shares ... in this offering comprise 50.00 percent of the company's present share capital," PK said in a statement, adding that the offer period is March 11 to March 21.
Trading in the Company's shares is expected to begin on or about April 3, 1997, PK said.
The offering will include a right for employees to subscribe for a maximum of 25,000 shares at 41.50 markka per share.
The offering will be lead-managed by Carnegie with OKOBANK and Opstock Securities Ltd as co-leads. -- Helsinki newsroom +3589 6805 0247, e-mail news@reuters.fi
